claims.text: Human endometriosis can rarely occur in an individual reported as male; one case does not give prevalence or establish cis status
Maternal microchimerism proposed as an etiologic hypothesis
Y chromosome FISH on the sampled endometrial tissue in one 31-patient study did not detect male fetal microchimerism
Ovarian follicle object detection was demonstrated on mouse histology not a clinical human PCOS diagnostic cohort
GSE153739 has 7 tissue samples: 4 cases and 3 controls
GSE266265 has 60 donors with approximately 466371 profiled single cells
MMP11 and VCAN showed compartment-specific immunostaining in an endometriosis tissue study
Immune and macrophage alterations in menstrual effluent have been reported in human cohorts
Kaggle endometriosis dataset rights and population sampling are not established by inspected listing
Ptarmigan-1 has been described in a company preprint and portal; independent target-specific reproduction is untested here
